description: Convert between profit margin and markup, and work out the price a target margin requires. Answers "what is my profit margin?", "what is the difference between margin and markup?" and "what should I charge for a 40% margin?" from cost and price.

price.description: What you sell it for. Optional if targetMarginPercent is given.

targetMarginPercent.description: The margin you want, as a percentage. Optional.

name: forge_profit_margin
